source_evidence: Many REITs are registered with the SEC and are publicly traded on a stock exchange. These are known as publicly traded REITs. Others may be registered with the SEC but are not publicly traded. These are known as non- traded REITs
answer: A REIT’s “publicly traded” or “non-traded” label describes whether its shares trade on a stock exchange. Publicly traded REITs are listed on an exchange, and you can purchase their shares through a broker. Non-traded REITs may also be registered with the SEC, but their shares are not publicly traded; they can be purchased through a broker participating in the REIT’s offering. So, “non-traded” does not necessarily mean “unregistered.”
